segments.text: Ain't nobody movin' it like me, I'm a Sumerian
I don't think you fellas understand me, I'm an Ariel
My methods is barbarian, my suit extraterrestrial
I'm in and out of the physical world, like it's the Marriott
Still I put it on my back, like it's a f***ing chariot
See the thousand versions of me die, I had to bury em
I'm purgin' out the axis, like I had a dose of psyllium
She's sayin' that I'll never make it out
Yeah, you wanna read between the lines
You gotta take off the full scab
The paper, not enough for me, I'd be where the tools at
This type of shop should definitely not wear my tools at
Spaceship only flies out if I'm puttin' the screws in
Rockin' never stops, we bumpin' LA, Dabaloo, go
The noise is an extension of me callin' Kazooie
I'm nowhere, nobody can touch me like I just got the flu, damn
